title: Toolchain currency: @claude-flow/mcp
command_template: test -n "$(bun info '@claude-flow/mcp' version 2>/dev/null)" && test "$(bun info '@claude-flow/mcp' version 2>/dev/null)" = "$(bun pm ls -g 2>/dev/null | grep -oE '@claude\-flow/mcp@[0-9][^ ]*' | head -1 | sed 's/.*@//')"
notes: The supplied grep expression emitted a non-fatal stray-backslash warning.
Bun's global root is runtime-cache-backed on this host, so the global installation may disappear after a reboot.
